_note: Presets هي تعليمات مساعدة وليست قيوداً. hint يُرسل للنموذج كإرشاد. بقية الحقول يستخدمها محرك Mock القالبي فقط ويمكن للنموذج الحقيقي تجاهلها.

image.name: سينمائي
image.hint: Cinematic still: film-like composition, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, graded colors.
image.style: cinematic film still, anamorphic look, subtle film grain
image.lighting: dramatic motivated lighting with soft rim light
image.negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted anatomy, extra fingers

image.name: واقعي (فوتوغرافي)
image.hint: Photorealistic photograph: natural light, real materials, believable proportions.
image.camera: 85mm lens, f/2.8, realistic depth of field
image.quality: ultra detailed, realistic skin and material texture, sharp focus
image.negative: cartoon, illustration, painting, plastic skin, oversaturated, watermark, text

image.name: فانتازيا
image.hint: Fantasy art: epic scale, magical atmosphere, rich costume and environment design.
image.palette: rich jewel tones with luminous accents
image.negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, modern objects

image.name: أنمي
image.hint: Anime style: clean line art, expressive faces, cel shading, vivid color.
image.style: anime illustration, clean line art, cel shading
image.lighting: bright stylized lighting with soft highlights
image.quality: high quality anime key visual, detailed background
image.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, low quality, bad anatomy, watermark, text

image.name: فانتازيا مظلمة
image.hint: Dark fantasy: grim, gothic, ominous atmosphere, weathered textures.
image.lighting: low-key lighting, cold moonlight with a single warm source
image.palette: desaturated, deep blacks, muted crimson accents
image.negative: bright cheerful colors, cartoon, blurry, low quality, watermark, text

image.name: خيال علمي
image.hint: Sci-fi: futuristic technology, believable hard surfaces, strong sense of scale.
image.style: science fiction concept art, hard-surface design
image.lighting: neon accents and cool ambient light, volumetric haze
image.quality: highly detailed, crisp, concept art quality
image.negative: medieval elements, blurry, low quality, watermark, text

image.name: منتج
image.hint: Product shot: clean background, controlled studio light, accurate materials, clear subject.
image.lighting: soft studio lighting with gentle reflections
image.quality: ultra sharp, accurate materials and reflections
image.negative: clutter, harsh shadows, blurry, watermark, text, distorted shape

image.name: بورتريه
image.hint: Portrait: focus on the face and expression, flattering light, shallow depth of field.
image.lighting: soft key light with gentle fill
image.camera: 85mm lens, f/1.8, eye-level, shallow depth of field
image.negative: deformed face, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, blurry, watermark, text

video.name: فيديو سينمائي
video.hint: Cinematic shot: motivated camera movement, film-like lighting, clear start-middle-end.
video.negative: jitter, flicker, warped faces, sudden cuts, text, watermark

video.name: أكشن
video.hint: Action: fast, energetic movement, dynamic handheld or tracking camera, clear cause and effect.
video.lighting: high-contrast lighting with flashes of light
video.camera: fast tracking shot with handheld energy
video.negative: jitter, motion artifacts, warped limbs, text, watermark

video.name: أجواء وسكون
video.hint: Atmospheric: slow, subtle motion, mood-driven, environmental details such as fog, wind and light shifts.

video.name: فيديو موسيقي
video.hint: Music video: stylized visuals, rhythmic motion and cuts, expressive lighting and camera.

video.name: مشهد فانتازي
video.hint: Fantasy scene: magical environment, creatures or effects with clear motion, epic scale.
video.camera: sweeping crane shot revealing the scene
video.negative: modern objects, jitter, warped anatomy, text, watermark
